summary: Positions 0-149: 76 photo, 17 unsure, 57 skip checked (sheets 00-16 opened; 17-18 not needed). photo: 54 keep_ok, 21 keep_wrong (3 are wall duplicates 1, 48, 105; 18 ordinary or lead-less revival/campus/theatre/listing-only buildings), 1 main_photo_wrong (Cottage Grove church, hidden by a fence). 2 field fixes (Wall House II movement, Villa Kudela concepts). 11 entries tagged ordinary (10 in keep_ok + the rescued Nestle HQ) = about 19% of 57 kept. unsure/skip: 3 rescued (Finnish Pavilion by Aalto, Renaat Braem House, Nestle HQ by Tschumi); the rest stay out (no photo of the building: 11, 13, 21, 39, 52, 68, 84, 87, 99, 135; rebuilt copy: Villa Munz 24; ordinary or no design reason: the rest). Empty-lead skips that are strong buildings and should be revisited once a lead exists: AEG Kleinmotorenfabrik and Haus Behrens (Behrens), Rietveld houses 16-19, Pavilhao Armando Arruda Pereira (Niemeyer), Peglezen (Plecnik), Isler halls, Masna burza (Fuchs), Holzmeister chapels, Haus Scharoun, Ernst Ludwig House (Olbrich), Casa Modes Tapies (Jujol). Niche-architect church skips not rescued: Franz-von-Sales-Kirche (Schwippert), Erloserkirche Landshut (Dollgast), St Albertus Magnus Berlin (Leitl). Notes: first photos of Kratochvilova vila and Festspielhaus Hellerau are vintage b/w views (best available); Blue Pavilion main is a dusk shot; Turku Main Library year stays null (prep 1903 is the old library; photo shows JKMM's new building); Montferri year 1999 is the completion year (begun 1925).
